comments.text:
I'm very surprised you did not mention hotel mirrors as a possibility Many times hotels and motels (especially older ones) are built with maintenance access on walls with plumbing. If there is a large mirror on these walls, a hole in the wall and a scratched piece of the back of the mirror provides a perfect peephole.
Also probably the easiest way to detect a hidden camera is with the camera in your cell phone. The cellphone's camera can detect infrared   light that most cameras use for low light conditions. It will appear as a bright light on your screen.
